newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BUILDMAX BUYS TWO BUILDING PRODUCT FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: BUILDMAX BUYS TWO BUILDING PRODUCT FIRMS.

text.p: Buildmax Ltd said on Friday it had bought the businesses of Watson Tile Corp and Watson Concrete for 16.50 million rand with effect from July 1, 1996.

The purchase condiseration will be settled by the issue of 2.5 million Buildmax shares at an issue price of 200 cents a share. The balance of 11.50 million rand will be paid in cash and financed partly from the 33.6 million rand rights issue completed in October.
The acquisitions offers Buildmax the opportunity to expand its current market sector, the company said.
